notes: No capital is named on either page (the later Roman province had Naissus from 284, Dardani page), so capitals is empty, against the schema's usual rule. Start -400 is a bridge to 'fourth century'. The Kingdom page and the Dardani page disagree on the conquest (28 BC annexed by Crassus; or 39 BC by Antonius, or 29/8 by Crassus). The Kingdom page puts the Bastarnae in 179 ('conquered the Dardani'), the Dardani page 183-177; neither gives a territorial change, so none is drawn. The extent is a reading (Kosovo with the Kumanovo and Skopje municipalities); the pages name parts of Serbia and Albania with no extent. Gazetteer: used the Natural Earth admin-1 spellings under country 'Macedonia' (Kumanovo, Skopje). Counterparts: kingdom-of-paeonia (written in this batch), antigonid-dynasty, roman-empire.
